content.text: Waking around 2am at 8 is pretty common — her sleep cycle is lighter in the second half of the night and any stress, growth spurts, or a screen too close to bedtime can be enough to break it. Try cutting screens 60 minutes before bed and adding a short wind-down routine, even five minutes of reading together.
